channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Giannis Antetokoumpo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Giannis Antetokoumpo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Giannis Antetokoumpo
item.description:
Tim Bontemps on Giannis Antetokoumpo:

“I think he's going to wait until next summer, he's got one year left on his deal. Assess the situation in Milwaukee and then decide what he wants to do as opposed to doing it now.”

Tim Bontemps on Giannis Antetokoumpo, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Sam Merrill on Jrue Holiday, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokoumpo
item.description:
“I really learned well from the guys in Milwaukee: Giannis (Antetokounpo), Khris (Middleton) and Jrue (Holiday) specifically,”

Sam Merrill on Jrue Holiday, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokoumpo, Mar 19, 2022. Source: Cache Valley Daily.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Giannis Antetokoumpo
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Kidd:

“We were going to try to rest Giannis. We had the lead and thought the game was under control. We wanted to finish with that group.”

Jason Kidd on Giannis Antetokoumpo, Feb 26, 2017. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Giannis Antetokoumpo
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Casey on Giannis:

“He's like a young colt. He's kind of gangly all over the place. He's still growing… He's a promising young player”

Dwane Casey on Giannis Antetokoumpo, Jan 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
